newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tatneft expects net profit drop in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Tatneft expects net profit drop in 1996.

text.p: Regional Russian oil company AO Tatneft expects its net profit to have fallen to around 2.0 trillion roubles in 1996 from 2.4 trillion in 1995, Prime-Tass news agency said on Monday, quoting Tatneft's chief executive.
The profits were calculated according to Russian accounting standards.
Rinat Galeyev also told the agency that Tatneft planned to produce 22.1 million tonnes of oil this year. It was not clear whether the figure included output from joint ventures.
Last year Tatneft produced 23.70 million tonnes of oil, down slightly from 1995 levels of 24.14 million tonnes. Joint ventures accounted for a further 1.1 million tonnes in 1996.
Tatneft has produced accounts to U.S. GAAP standards, audited by Price Waterhouse, according to which its 1995 net profit was $255 million.
